qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Best-in-class operator in North American containerboard with ~90% vertical integration, but containerboard and corrugated packaging are semi-commodity industrial products. Pricing follows published industry benchmark indices (RISI) and capacity cycles rather than unilateral economic pricing power.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (Moat Archetype = None, 3b = N, REJECT). Best-in-class operational execution and high integration in containerboard cannot overcome the cyclical, semi-commodity reality of corrugated packaging. Realized box prices track industry benchmark indices and capacity cycles rather than unilateral pricing power.
qualitative.evidence: 10-year median ROIC is ~12.8%, with FY2025 ROIC temporarily dipping to 10.5-11.5% post-Greif containerboard acquisition ($1.8B cash). Operating margins average 12-14%, but net income exhibits cyclical swings ($738M in 2018 -> $461M in 2020 -> $1,022M in 2022 peak -> $765M in 2023 -> $805M in 2024). Packaging accounts for >90% of revenue. High capital intensity and industry capacity waves prevent enduring pricing power above inflation.
